audience: Shopify merchants who sell subscriptions with Smartrr

useCases.title: Find subscriptions with failed bills
useCases.text: The AI lists billing attempts with amount, status, retry count and error, and shows the subscription and customer behind each failed one.

useCases.title: List subscriptions that renew soon
useCases.text: The AI lists subscriptions filtered by status and next billing date, with line items, selling plan and customer.

useCases.title: Review the history and orders of a customer's subscription
useCases.text: The AI finds a customer, lists their subscriptions, and reads the recent events (pause, skip, cancel, billing failures) and orders of one subscription.

useCases.title: Track active subscriptions and subscribers per day
useCases.text: The AI reads the number of active subscriptions and active subscribers for each day in a date range, so you can see the trend.

useCases.title: Pause, resume or cancel a subscription
useCases.text: The AI pauses a subscription until a date, resumes a paused or cancelled one, or cancels it with a cancellation reason.

useCases.title: Skip an order, move a billing date or retry a failed bill
useCases.text: The AI skips a scheduled order, sets a new next billing date, or checks the bills and retries a failed one. A retry charges the customer.
